verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a note-taking app, but the evidence pack never documents a first-party way to select many notes and act on them at once. Nearby items do not qualify. Bases lets you view and edit files and properties, but nothing says edits apply to many items together. Automatic link updates on rename are a side effect of a single action. The Importer, the plugin API and editing plain-text files with outside tools are a different story, a developer building block and a user workaround respectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
